question: What is the meaning of dismantling in relation to circularity at end of product use period?
data_group: circularity at end of product use period
description: Dismantling is the process of taking apart a product in a way that it can be reassembled and made operational again. This is important for achieving the highest possible level of reused and recycled content from end-of-life products. It is different from disassembly, which is relevant for prolonging product lifetime. Examples of metrics to count the steps of dismantling can be found in EN 45554:2020, Clause A.2.
